reviews.text: We recently used the services of Slick Blinds and we are extremely happy with their service. The initial enquiry was followed by a visit by Ravi (owner) with catalogs and we spent more than an hour in consultation. Ravi was good in providing various suggestions and helped us in choosing the right blinds. The team was regularly providing updates on the status and the overall process was seamless. Special mention to Tejas who handled the coordination and scheduling. He was very detailed and custom

I have intentionally waited a year to write this review of Slick Blinds. As a person who works for a manufacturer, I recognize that the purchase process is important, but more importantly it is how the POST-purchase goes. Ravi and his team are OUTSTANDING. Very responsive, polite, and friendly. Warranty support has been second to none, THAT is what matters to me!!!! I know I can trust this company and will highly recommend to friends and family. They will get all of my future business. Thank you

My friend recommended I check out Slick Blinds near me in Prosper, and I’m so glad I did. Their wide selection of blinds and curtain designs made it easy to find the perfect fit for my new home. Ravi and his team were incredibly helpful throughout the selection process, offering expert advice and personalized service. The installation was smooth and hassle-free, and the final result exceeded our expectations. If you’re in Prosper, Texas and need quality window treatments, I highly recommend Slic
